title: A Wonderful Alhambra Tour
text: I really enjoyed my visit to the Alhambra, and Antonio made the experience even better. He is very knowledgeable about Andalusian history and speaks excellent Arabic. His explanations were interesting and engaging, and I learned a lot from him. He was definitely one of the highlights of my visit. Thank you, Antonio! لمتحدثين العربية اختاروا انتونيو بدون تردد !

title: Alhambra Guided Tour
text: Fourth time visiting the Alhambra! Dara was our guide and did an amazing job, I highly recommend! I learned a lot of new and interesting things, even with prior visits!
author: Quest63342576285

title: Amazing Alhambra Tour with Jana – Worth It, but Pricey!
text:
Visiting the Alhambra in Granada was definitely one of the highlights of our trip. The beautiful gardens, incredible architecture, fascinating history, and great company made it a truly memorable experience.

We were a small group of around 10–12 people, which made the tour feel much more personal and enjoyable.

Our guide, Jana, was excellent! She was knowledgeable, friendly, and shared so many interesting stories that really brought the history of the Alhambra to life. We genuinely enjoyed every minute of the tour with her.

For the guided tour itself, and especially for Jana, it’s an easy 5

title: SPECTACULAR
text: Victoria, a simply SPECTACULAR guide! Patient, kind, respectful, affectionate, and with great knowledge and wisdom in how she expresses herself... I would go back with her without a doubt!
author: nathaliecL6019LN

title: The Alhambra in the morning.
text:
This was a very thorough and interesting look at the Alhambra. I was very excited to visit this site and our guide Victoria took great care of us. She had great explanations of the historical facts and also told us many interesting anecdotes. Victoria led us efficiently along the visit route; as well she would also pause at places with a particularly lovely view for photo ops. 
I enjoyed this tour of the fascinating Alhambra very much.
author: laurahR3754EE

title: Knowledgeable guide, beautiful tour, small group kept things personal and well paced
text: Victoria, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the Alhambra. She took time to explain the many layered aspects of the history and architecture, leading us to areas where not all of the tours went and helping us navigate the crowds. She answered all of our questions enthusiastically and was delightful to spend the morning with.
author: Zabrina D

title: With with Jana, You’re Guided by Both Mind and Soul
text:
Jana is knowledgeable, kind-hearted, and knows the area exceptionally well. She knows all the secrets of the place and every little detail, even the ones you might easily miss. She knows it so well that even the local cats recognise her and come straight to her for treats and a little affection! 😊
Regards, Dina
author: B2819MEdinae

title: Excellent tour in the company of Anis
text:
An exceptional tour of the Alhambra thanks to Anis! We had a wonderful time in his company. He is a passionate, cultured, and captivating guide who knows perfectly how to convey the history and anecdotes of this incredible place. His explanations are clear, interesting, and punctuated with numerous details that make the visit even more enriching.

Anis knew how to make this discovery as exciting as it was pleasant. We highly recommend his services to anyone who wishes to discover the Alhambra in the best conditions.

A huge thank you to Anis for this superb tour! We recommend 100%!
author: Eddie_B

title: An exceptional guide of an unbelievably beautiful place!
text:
Celia was a delightful tour guide. She clearly knew and loved el Alhambra and its history. In spite of the heavy rains, Celia made the visit informative and fun.
What a beautiful place and experience!
author: Trip41910872416

title: Fantastic tour, but very expensive if you book last-minute
text: Cristina was a wonderful freelance guide. Friendly and personable and so knowledgeable about Granada and the Alhambra. Really got the local experience. Two stars for value only because our (last-minute) booking was over 10x normal admission price (~$210 per ticket). Doesn't feel fair to price-gouge like that.
